source.x-scope: Re-review of the fix pass 763d81f..658ba43 (PR 22) plus verification of F01-F30. safe_auto fixes were not applied: review-role session.

findings.title: handoff write ignores a pending gate, needs-human status and entry checks, then overwrites data.gate
findings.reason: Write now enforces pending gates, blocking questions and phase entry checks; relay regressions cover bypass attempts.
findings.x-fix: In write, before closing phase P, reject with E_GATE_PENDING/E_BLOCKING_OPEN (exit 3) when data.gate.required && !data.gate.approved_by or status is needs-human, and re-run the phase entry checks (or require receive to have populated entry_checked). Only then reset gate at line 319. Add a relay test.
findings.x-evidence: Line 289 only compares next_phase; line 319 replaces gate with approved_by:null. receive (175-176) enforces the gate but write does not, so skipping receive erases an unapproved scope or pre-code gate (C6).

x-rereview.evidence: Write runs entryErrors before merging --from-json; pending gate and needs-human exit 3 with the baton unchanged (correctness, adversarial, testing).

findings.title: Review write trusts agent-asserted blocking_findings and defaults next to land instead of routing to implement/work
findings.reason: Reopened: the feature lane now derives the count and routes to implement, but the quick lane cannot. Quick review exit findings-fixed-or-dismissed fails for any open finding, so write returns E_EXIT_UNMET before saving and the baton stays at next_phase review; receive/write work then fail E_TRANSITION. relay.test.mjs:502 only asserts result.data.next_phase and guards persistence with if (!result.errors?.length), so it passes while the write fails. See also F31 (findings_path not pinned).
findings.x-fix: When review routes to work/implement because blocking_findings > 0, evaluate only findings-json-valid (and quick-scope-held); apply findings-fixed-or-dismissed / findings-mapped only when next is land. Make the quick relay test assert no errors and next_phase work on disk.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: review.json with an open P0 and asserted blocking_findings:0 wrote next=land and receive --phase land exited 0. An honest count without --next still produced next=land status=ready. phase-contracts.md says Review -> implement is chosen automatically.
findings.x-prior-reason: Validated findings supply the blocking count; review routes back to implement/work and land recomputes blockers.

findings.title: Converge re-entry cannot be written: after_converge handoff always fails with E_TRANSITION
findings.reason: Reopened: the CLI accepts converge re-entry only with --mode converge, but the mandatory after_converge hook prompt (.specify/extensions/baton/commands/handoff.md and baton/speckit-extension/commands/handoff.md) says only that after_converge maps to implement and never passes --mode converge. The hook-shaped `handoff write --phase implement` with next_phase review still throws E_TRANSITION, as in the original evidence.
findings.x-fix: Either accept an implement write when phase_completed is implement and next_phase is review (converge re-entry) without the flag, or add `--mode converge` for after_converge to both handoff.md hook prompts; add a hook-shaped relay test.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: after receive --mode converge, write --phase implement (with or without --mode converge) exits 1 "Expected review, not implement"; the handoff hook maps after_converge to implement. relay.test.mjs:241 only covers receive.
findings.x-prior-reason: Converge receive and implement write can re-enter the review transition.

findings.title: before_specify receive has no first-phase path: crashes with E_INTERNAL (exit 10) or rejects an escalated quick baton
findings.reason: Reopened: the first-phase short-circuit (handoff.mjs:159) fires only when specs/ has no feature directory. Reproduced in a clone of 658ba43: with specs/001-baton-template present, `handoff receive --phase specify` exits 1 E_TRANSITION "Expected review, received specify"; with two features and a non-feature branch it exits 2 E_USAGE. The mandatory before_specify hook therefore blocks every feature after the first. F04 tests cover only an empty specs/ and a single dir without a baton.
findings.x-fix: For receive --phase specify without --feature/--quick, return the first-phase result unless a located baton actually has next_phase specify; add relay tests with one finished feature and with two features on a non-feature branch.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: fresh repo -> E_INTERNAL scandir specs exit 10; feature dir without baton -> E_INTERNAL ENOENT handoff.md exit 10. receive.md promises a CLI first-phase result.
findings.x-prior-reason: First specify receive handles absent feature directories and escalated quick context.

findings.title: after_specify write has no plain-feature path, and handoff new --feature hardcodes next_phase clarify so specify --next plan is impossible
findings.reason: Reopened: the plain first specify write works only with --feature. The after_specify hook prompt runs `handoff write --phase <phase> --from-json <file>` without --feature. Reproduced on branch 002-next-thing with specs/002-next-thing/spec.md: exit 10 E_INTERNAL ENOENT on specs/002-next-thing/handoff.md, because handoff.mjs:375 rethrows unless options.feature is a string although locate() already resolved the path.
findings.x-fix: Derive the feature from the resolved path (basename(dirname(path))) when --feature is absent; allow the same for --from-quick/--from-brainstorm or make the hook pass --feature; add a hook-shaped test.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: write --phase specify --feature 001-alpha without a baton -> E_INTERNAL ENOENT; after handoff new --feature -> E_TRANSITION "Expected clarify, not specify". README/quickstart allow skipping clarify.
findings.x-prior-reason: Plain first specify write creates the baton and can skip clarify when the contract permits.

findings.title: Feature is not inferred from the branch; any repo with two feature dirs breaks every hook call without --feature
findings.reason: Feature resolution uses branch or feature metadata before the single-directory fallback.
findings.x-fix: Implement contracts/cli.md:32: infer the feature from the NNN-slug branch name or .specify/feature.json before falling back to the single-dir rule; include the candidate list in the E_USAGE message.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: two specs dirs -> handoff next exits 2 E_USAGE. receive.md/handoff.md hook prompts never pass --feature.

x-rereview.evidence: locate() infers the feature from an NNN-slug branch, then .specify/feature.json; E_USAGE lists candidates. Branch test is weak (see F51).

findings.title: update overwrites merged .specify/extensions.yml and Copilot hooks with the pristine payload, dropping adopter hooks
findings.reason: Update remerges adopter Spec Kit and Copilot hooks before comparing managed bytes.
findings.x-fix: Apply the same mergeExtensions/mergeHooks step as init.mjs:238-253 to the staged desired bytes before comparing and writing; add an update test with an adopter hook in extensions.yml.
findings.x-evidence: update stages init into an empty dir (line 81), so desired is the unmerged payload; when the merged file is unmodified since install (line 112 passes) it is replaced at line 127.

x-rereview.evidence: update merges adopter extensions.yml and copilot-hooks.json; two integration tests with real init + adopter content.

findings.title: Shipped troubleshooting docs name a single organisation's internal package-feed hostnames
findings.reason: Shipped troubleshooting now describes approved registry mirrors without organisation-specific hostnames.
findings.x-fix: Replace the two feed URLs with a generic "your organisation's approved npm/PyPI mirror" and show the env vars (npm_config_registry, UV_DEFAULT_INDEX) with placeholder values.
findings.x-evidence: constitution.md:93 forbids adopter-specific hostnames in Baton; lines 27-28 contain them and the denylist does not catch hostnames.

x-rereview.evidence: docs/08-troubleshooting.md is registry-neutral; the hostname only survives in a test literal (see F44).

findings.title: diff-nonempty is empty once implement increments are merged to main and trivially true from baton bookkeeping
findings.reason: Reopened: nothing in the CLI, hooks or skills records the diff-base decision, and review.json does not exist at a first review receive. This re-review received only because the previous review.json supplied base 8aeed8a. A first review after merged increments still falls back to merge-base HEAD origin/HEAD and reports 0 changed files; the durable-base tests inject the decision by hand. Related trivially-true and supersede gaps: F33, F34.
findings.x-fix: Have the CLI append a deterministic diff-base decision (x-base-commit = HEAD) when it writes analyze -> implement or at the first implement receive; add a relay test that merges implement commits into origin/HEAD before review receive.
findings.x-evidence: This review hit it: receive --phase review failed "0 changed files" on origin/main because PRs #1-#20 were merged; changedFiles (line 61) diffs merge-base HEAD origin/HEAD and adds untracked files. Override recorded as a baton decision.
findings.x-prior-reason: Diff checks use the recorded review/base commit across merged increments and exclude baton bookkeeping.

findings.title: acceptance-evidence regex can be satisfied by registry headers or placeholder text, and the id is not escaped
findings.reason: Acceptance evidence is read from result rows and rejects registry headers and placeholder notes.
findings.x-fix: Parse the Acceptance Registry table and require a non-placeholder red->green (or justified n/a) evidence cell per registered id; escape item.id before building the RegExp; add negative tests.
findings.x-evidence: Any line with the id followed by the words red, green or n/a passes, including the registry row header text.

x-rereview.evidence: Registry and evidence tables are parsed; headers, placeholders and regex ids no longer satisfy the check. Policy gap on n/a recorded as F37.

findings.title: --from-json replaces decisions and open_questions wholesale, so an agent can delete human answers or forge human:* decisions
findings.reason: Supplied decisions merge append-only and cannot forge human answers or remove blocking questions.
findings.x-fix: Merge decisions append-only: keep existing ids unchanged, reject supplied entries whose by starts with human: and never drop an existing blocking question except via handoff answer.
findings.x-evidence: Object.assign(data, supplied) at line 293 overwrites arrays; handoff answer (213-227) is the only intended path to resolve a question.

x-rereview.evidence: decisions/open_questions are append-only; new human:* decisions rejected. New-id forgery branch is untested (F51).

findings.title: refresh re-hashes every artifact including the baton itself, keeps a prior gate approval and crashes without decisions
findings.reason: Refresh skips self-hashing, resets approval on source changes and initializes missing decisions.
findings.x-fix: Skip the baton file itself, reset gate.approved_by when a gated source-of-truth hash changes, and default data.decisions ??= [] before push (line 392).
findings.x-evidence: A quick baton listed in its own artifacts becomes permanently stale after refresh; the gate survives changed artifacts.

x-rereview.evidence: refresh skips the self path, initialises decisions and revokes approval on a source-of-truth edit. Derived-artifact gap recorded as F35.

findings.title: W_WEAKENED_CONTRACT compares only exit checks, so a phases.yml override can drop human_gate or entry gate checks silently
findings.reason: Override warnings include missing entry checks and disabled human gates.
findings.x-fix: Also compare each default entry check and warn when human_gate is turned off; add phases unit tests.
findings.x-evidence: checkWeakenedContracts uses phaseForLane(defaults, lane).exit only.

x-rereview.evidence: checkWeakenedContracts compares entry, exit and human_gate; phases.test covers removed entry checks and disabled gates.

findings.title: update reports a conflict (exit 4) on every run for a customised constitution
findings.reason: Update leaves protected adopter constitution content untouched.
findings.x-fix: Skip protected paths (init.mjs:15 protectedPath) in update exactly as init does, instead of comparing them to the pristine template.
findings.x-evidence: init plans the constitution from the template (init.mjs:217-219); an adopter edit makes the digest differ from the manifest, so line 112 writes a conflict every update.

x-rereview.evidence: protectedPath skips the constitution in update; test asserts exit 0 and no .new file.

findings.title: update restages with --packs only, dropping an adopter's --script ps/py choice
findings.reason: Manifest tracks script flavour so ps/py installs remain on the same flavour after update.
findings.x-fix: Record the script flavour in the manifest at init and pass --script <flavour> when staging in update.
findings.x-evidence: Only --packs and --from are forwarded, so ps/py script installs are replaced by sh scripts or reported as conflicts.

x-rereview.evidence: installedScript keeps the flavour and update restages with it. Tests only exercise the uv fallback (F51); init regression recorded as F39.

findings.title: Contracted warnings W_NO_BATON and W_ASSUMPTION_DUE are never emitted
findings.reason: Validation emits W_NO_BATON and W_ASSUMPTION_DUE with focused coverage.
findings.x-fix: Emit W_NO_BATON for a specs dir with spec.md and no handoff.md (suggest handoff init --infer) and W_ASSUMPTION_DUE when an assumption revisit_at equals next_phase; add validate tests.
findings.x-evidence: handoff-contract.md:115-118 defines both; no source file references either code.

x-rereview.evidence: validate emits W_NO_BATON and W_ASSUMPTION_DUE with tests.

findings.title: Malformed review.json crashes the findings checks with E_INTERNAL (exit 10) instead of an unmet check
findings.reason: Invalid findings JSON produces an unmet check instead of an internal crash.
findings.x-fix: Wrap JSON.parse in try/catch and return answer(false, "review.json is not valid JSON: ..."); add a test.
findings.x-evidence: findings-json-valid is meant to report invalid findings files, but a parse error escapes evaluateBuiltIn.

x-rereview.evidence: findings-* and no-blocking-findings wrap JSON.parse and return unmet.

findings.title: A failing local-checks-pass entry check is reported as E_MISSING_ARTIFACT
findings.reason: Failed local checks are reported with a check failure rather than a missing artifact.
findings.x-fix: Map local-checks-pass to a dedicated code (e.g. E_CHECK_FAILED) or E_EXIT_UNMET with the per-check exit codes, and test a failing configured check.
findings.x-evidence: The receive code mapping falls through to E_MISSING_ARTIFACT for every unlisted check id, which misleads the land phase.

x-rereview.evidence: local-checks-pass maps to E_CHECK_FAILED; the code is undocumented (F42).

findings.title: lock verify has no tests and malformed lock JSON surfaces as E_INTERNAL
findings.reason: Lock verification covers match, tamper and malformed JSON with E_LOCK_MISMATCH.
findings.x-fix: Add tests for a matching lock, a tampered file (E_LOCK_MISMATCH) and malformed JSON mapped to a documented code.
findings.x-evidence: No test references lock verify or E_LOCK_MISMATCH although CI relies on it.

x-rereview.evidence: lock verify maps malformed JSON and bad entries to E_LOCK_MISMATCH; new lock.test.mjs.

findings.title: Relay tests miss converge write, write-with-pending-gate and answer/approve guard paths
findings.reason: Relay tests cover converge write, pending-gate write and answer/approve guards.
findings.x-fix: Add relay cases: converge receive+write, write while a gate is pending (expect exit 3), answer with an unknown id or choice, approve twice.
findings.x-evidence: Only the converge receive is asserted; F01/F03 would have been caught.

x-rereview.evidence: Converge write, pending-gate write, answer guards and double approval are covered. The quick F02 test is masked (see F02).

findings.title: update/init --from archive is not checked against the release SHA256SUMS
findings.reason: Deferred: archive verification needs an agreed checksum-distribution and failure contract; no archive install is part of this fix-pass delivery.
findings.x-fix: Verify the archive digest against a SHA256SUMS file next to it (or a --sha256 flag) before extracting.
findings.x-evidence: contracts/ci.md:110 publishes SHA256SUMS; src has no reference to it.

x-rereview.evidence: Re-review verdict: deferral acceptable for v0.1, non-blocking. --from takes an operator-chosen local archive and Baton downloads nothing; release.yml publishes SHA256SUMS plus provenance and its notes say to verify them. Before the first public release add a verify-before---from line to docs/07-updating.md.

findings.title: local-checks-pass runs shell commands from the branch's own .baton/config.yml during receive/write
findings.reason: Deferred: enforcing a trust boundary on configured project checks changes the reviewer execution contract; requires explicit policy decision.
findings.x-fix: Document the trust boundary and print the commands before running them in receive land; optionally require config.yml checks to match the default branch.
findings.x-evidence: A PR that edits config.yml checks gets command execution when a reviewer runs the land receive.

x-rereview.evidence: Re-review verdict: deferral acceptable for v0.1, non-blocking, documentation expected. No workflow runs handoff receive/write, so no pull_request-to-secrets path exists; exposure equals running npm test on a checked-out branch. The F01 fix widened it (land write preflight now also runs the checks), so document the trust boundary in README and SECURITY.md.

findings.title: The personal-data scan strips code spans and fences in Markdown, so identities inside backticks pass
findings.reason: Deferred: scanning code spans requires an agreed placeholder allowlist and false-positive policy before changing privacy validation.
findings.x-fix: Scan code spans too but allow documented placeholder domains (example.com/.invalid) instead of skipping all code.
findings.x-evidence: Lines 31-33 remove fenced and inline code before matching.

x-rereview.evidence: Re-review verdict: deferral acceptable for v0.1, non-blocking. Frontmatter is scanned in full and configured terms scan the whole text; only Markdown code spans in bodies are skipped. It is an accidental-leak false negative, not a trust-boundary break. Document the limitation.

findings.title: mvp-windows-smoke.yml is not in the maintainer workflow list, so guard checks and --prune-workflows skip it
findings.reason: Windows smoke is inventoried as a dormant maintainer workflow and removed by adopter pruning.
findings.x-fix: Add mvp-windows-smoke.yml to maintainerWorkflows and the template-cleanup dormant list.
findings.x-evidence: The workflow is guarded (line 10) but not listed.

x-rereview.evidence: mvp-windows-smoke.yml is in maintainerWorkflows and keep_dormant; --prune-workflows removes it.

findings.title: A paragraph splits the adopter command table, so the models apply, adopt and uninstall rows do not render
findings.reason: The adopter command rows form one contiguous Markdown table.
findings.x-fix: Move the implement -> review paragraph below the table (after the uninstall row).
findings.x-evidence: Lines 42-44 interrupt the table.

x-rereview.evidence: The adopter command table in cli.md is contiguous; docs test guards it.

findings.title: handoff next omits gate and status, so agents must also call show to know they are blocked
findings.reason: Next output includes status, gate and blocking question identifiers.
findings.x-fix: Include status, gate.required/approved_by and blocking question ids in the next payload.
findings.x-evidence: The payload has command, role, model and instruction only.

x-rereview.evidence: handoff next returns status, gate and blocking_questions. Instruction text when gated recorded as F41.

findings.title: baton-review skill does not specify the --from-json payload shape or --next implement for blocking findings
findings.reason: Reopened and raised to P2: only the sync source baton/skills/baton-review/SKILL.md changed. The shipped copy .github/skills/baton-review/SKILL.md (packs/core.yml maps it; init installs it) is still the pre-fix blob and tells agents to record the exact blocking count themselves. The two files hash differently; release.yml runs sync --check, which will flag the drift. The F27 tests read only baton/skills.
findings.x-fix: Regenerate the shipped copy through baton sync (or byte-copy and confirm with a hosted sync --check) and add a check that every from: baton skill in packs/*.yml equals its baton/skills source.
findings.x-evidence: Agents must read handoff.mjs to learn the allowed keys.
findings.x-prior-reason: Review skill documents the findings_path payload and CLI-derived blocking count and routing.

findings.title: Tests create temp repos inside the source tree (test/fixtures/handoffs/.relay-*) which are not gitignored
findings.reason: Interrupted fixture repositories are ignored by a scoped .gitignore rule; relay test covers it.
findings.x-fix: Create temp repos under os.tmpdir() or add the prefixes to .gitignore.
findings.x-evidence: An interrupted test run leaves untracked dirs that also feed diff-nonempty/changedFiles.

x-rereview.evidence: Relay temp repos are gitignored. Other new in-tree temp prefixes recorded as F52.

findings.title: phaseDefaults duplicates baton/templates/phases.yml with only a partial drift check
findings.reason: Defaults and template are deep-equality tested, including quick-lane gate values.
findings.x-fix: Add a unit test asserting deep equality between phaseDefaults and the parsed template (or generate one from the other at build).
findings.x-evidence: Only exit checks are compared today.

x-rereview.evidence: phases-defaults.test deep-equals phaseDefaults with baton/templates/phases.yml.

findings.title: Malformed --from-json exits 10 (E_INTERNAL) instead of a usage error
findings.reason: Malformed --from-json yields E_USAGE with the input file.
findings.x-fix: Catch JSON.parse and throw E_USAGE exit 2 naming the file.
findings.x-evidence: JSON.parse is unguarded.

x-rereview.evidence: Malformed --from-json is E_USAGE exit 2 naming the file. Out-of-repo or missing file recorded as F53.

findings.title: review.findings_path is agent-supplied and never pinned, so an open P0 in the canonical review.json still reaches land
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: In write --phase review and in no-blocking-findings require findings_path to equal {feature_dir}/review.json (feature) or .baton/quick/<slug>.review.json (quick); reject review in --from-json outside the review phase; add a relay test with a clean decoy file.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced in a clone of 658ba43: canonical review.json with an open P0, clean copy at specs/001-baton-template/clean.json, write --phase review with {review:{findings_path:"specs/001-baton-template/clean.json"}} -> next_phase land; receive --phase land passed no-blocking-findings (only local-checks-pass failed in the clone).

findings.title: Write preflight re-runs fresh:* entry checks after the phase edited its own artifacts, so implement and review writes fail E_STALE_ARTIFACT until an unprompted refresh
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: At write time re-check only gate, needs-human and blocking-question conditions (freshness belongs to receive), or have write rely on entry_checked recorded at receive; add relay tests that edit tasks.md between receive and write.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: appending a task line to tasks.md then write --phase review -> exit 1 E_STALE_ARTIFACT "fresh:tasks unmet: stale: tasks". Implement adds evidence rows to tasks.md, so every canonical implement write hits it; refresh is the documented workaround (error-codes.md) and the fix pass itself used it (D56-D61).
findings.x-severity-note: correctness rated P1; kept at P2 because error-codes.md documents handoff refresh as the remediation.

findings.title: diff-nonempty is trivially true again: specs/<feature>/ planning artifacts, analysis.md and review.json count, and a prior review base keeps it true forever
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: Exclude specs/<feature>/ Baton and Spec Kit artifacts (or count only paths outside specs/<feature>/) for the review entry, and record the reviewed head as the next base so a re-review of an unchanged tree fails; update phase-contracts.md.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced by adversarial: only a tasks.md checkbox and analysis.md changed -> met:true "2 changed files". review.json base stays at the first review base, so re-review passes with no new code.

findings.title: A wrong or unreachable diff-base cannot be corrected: reviewBase uses the first matching decision and an unknown SHA reports "No merge-base available"
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: Use the last diff-base decision (findLast) and verify the base with git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit}, reporting "Recorded diff base <sha> is not in this clone" and falling back to merge-base.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: D1 diff-base deadbeefcafe plus D2 diff-base HEAD with a new file -> met:false "No merge-base available"; decisions are append-only after F11.

findings.title: refresh keeps the pre-code approval after a derived tasks.md edit or an artifact role change
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: When a gate is required, clear approval on refresh if any hashed artifact or read_first entry changed (treat a missing prior sha256 as a change), and do not let --from-json change the role of an existing artifact.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: analyze baton approved; tasks.md T001 reworded -> receive implement E_STALE_ARTIFACT; refresh succeeds with approval kept; receive implement then passes.

findings.title: Implement write can drop pre-registered acceptance_checks, so acceptance-evidence only checks what the agent kept
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: Make acceptance_checks append-only after the tasks phase (reuse appendOnly) and have the implement exit compare them with the tasks.md Acceptance Registry.
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced: AC-US1-2 lacked evidence; write --phase implement with acceptance_checks [AC-US1-1] succeeded and saved the shrunken list.

findings.title: acceptance-evidence accepts n/a for checks registered expect_initial fail, and the fix pass relabelled partial and missing-red results as n/a without a human decision
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: Accept n/a only when the registry row expects n/a; add a partial result that is unmet unless a tagged human decision waives it; restore AC-US7-1 to partial and record a human waiver (or report unmet) for fail-registered checks without a retained red run.
findings.x-evidence: Constitution V: a partial result is reported as partial; checks are not redefined without a recorded human decision. tasks.md:489 AC-US7-1 changed from "partial" to "n/a"; fail-registered checks read "n/a - original red run was not retained"; D60 is by implementation-session.

findings.title: findings.schema requires task on every non-dismissed finding, so a quick-lane review with a fixed finding fails findings-json-valid
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: Require task only for feature-lane open findings (move the rule into findings-mapped-to-tasks-or-dismissed) and state the quick-lane rule in the baton-review skill.
findings.x-evidence: Probe: quick review.json with {disposition:"fixed"} and no task -> E_EXIT_UNMET "/findings/0/task: must have required property task"; the quick lane has no tasks.

findings.title: init/update with a ps or py flavour now drop the bash scripts while the locked speckit skills still call .specify/scripts/bash/*.sh
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: Take the flavour-specific speckit skills/commands from the generated project together with its scripts, or keep the bash scripts until they are regenerated; add a test that every script path referenced by an installed speckit skill exists after init --script ps.
findings.x-evidence: init.mjs:171 skips lock entries under .specify/scripts/bash/ when a generated project exists; .github/skills/speckit-*/SKILL.md from the lock reference .specify/scripts/bash/check-prerequisites.sh.

findings.title: diff-nonempty subject filter only counts untracked files under src|test|docs|specs|packs|baton|.github, missing new adopter files elsewhere
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: Replace the directory allowlist with the exclusion list (.baton/, specs/*/handoff.md, scratch/tmp) or make roots configurable; replace the boolean|subject parameter with an options object.
findings.x-evidence: Tracked and staged changes still count; only unstaged new files such as app/x.ts are missed (maintainability rated P2).

findings.title: handoff next still tells the agent to run the next phase and exits 0 while the gate is pending or a blocking question is open
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: When gated or blocked, set instruction to the required approve/answer command and add blocked: true (or exit 3); update the cli.md handoff next row, which also omits the new fields.
findings.x-evidence: Probe: gate required and unapproved -> instruction "Switch model to gpt-6-sol, then run /speckit-implement", exit 0.

findings.title: E_CHECK_FAILED is not in the error-code catalogue
findings.reason: New in re-review of the fix pass; not fixed in this review-role session.
findings.x-fix: Add E_CHECK_FAILED (exit 1) to docs/reference/error-codes.md and the handoff-contract error table.
